title: Today vertical slice (end-to-end)
pipeline_proven: L1-L6 sealed data -> L7 backend (FastAPI) -> Current Today State -> Product API -> Flutter UI

inputs.flutter_toolchain: Flutter 3.41.1 stable, Dart 3.11.0, JDK 17, Android SDK present

screens: today_screen.dart (状态/主原因/今日行动/更新于 HH:MM/判断已更新/查看依据/Q&A入口/Context入口/feedback prompt/版本历史)
evidence_screen.dart (Level-3 drill-down: series chart + baseline + quality, only deviating metrics)
history_screen.dart (honest Phase-F placeholder + real append-only judgment version history)
patterns_screen.dart (actionable patterns + counterevidence + accumulation state, wired to /patterns)
me_screen.dart (notification mode, engine connection, model-call usage transparency, about)
qa_screen.dart (decision-assistant shell, Phase E engine wiring noted in-app)
context_screen.dart (natural language + quick chips, no questionnaire, Phase E wiring noted)
shared: api_client.dart (L7Client + TodayPayload; app never computes health state)
main.dart (4 fixed bottom tabs 今日/历史/我的规律/我的; instant-open local cache)

cases: stable day renders zero actions (no filler advice)
notable change shows conclusion/cause/actions/更新于/查看依据/两个入口
medical safety (E) renders action ABOVE cause

dart_e2e_transport.note: exercises the exact HttpApiClient code path against the live backend

tests.cors_preflight: OPTIONS /today returns access-control-allow-origin:* in local env only

builds.web_release: PASS (app/build/web, rebuilt after Phase E/G screens)
builds.android_debug_apk: PASS — app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk (147 MB) built 2026-08-18 after fixing CN-network blocks: Aliyun/Tencent maven mirrors in app gradle files + patched Flutter SDK includeBuild settings + global init script (settings-level) + NDK pinned to fully-installed 27.1.12297006 (28.2 dir was an incomplete download; dl.google.com unreachable)

today_first_screen_shows: 最可能原因 (cause.text, verbatim from engine)
今日行动 (<=3, 0 allowed on stable)
查看依据 (Level 2 sentences + Level 3 drill-down page)
Context 入口 (补充我的情况)
Q&A 入口 (问问我的状态)
acceptance_gate.secrets_not_in_client: token only; model credentials never leave backend

run_instructions.backend: cd backend; set env (see .env.example); python -m uvicorn l7.api.app:create_app --factory --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8707
run_instructions.app_android: flutter run (device) or install app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk; set server address in 我的 tab (emulator: http://10.0.2.2:8707)
run_instructions.app_web: serve app/build/web statically; default base url http://127.0.0.1:8707

known_limitations: Q&A engine wiring and Context structured extraction are Phase E (UI shells are live and honest about it).
History episode projection is Phase F; version history is already real.
Notifications are settings-only until Phase G.
APK is debug-signed for the owner's device; release signing is a Phase H packaging item.
